name: Michiko Konda
description: Konda's daughter who struck him down.

description_citations.text: "Takeshi Konda". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko abandons her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi about the kami's rage.
timeline.quote: abandons the shrinking safety of her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi

citation.text: "Champions of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko meets the thief Toshi Umezawa and realizes she may need unthinkable alliances.
timeline.quote: she realizes that to avert the destruction of Kamigawa, she may have to make some unthinkable alliances

citation.text: "Champions of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Myojin of Life's Web has Michiko captured hoping her death would end the war; the princess escapes and the forest is attacked by the Moonfolk of Oboro.
timeline.quote: She had Michiko captured, hoping that her death would end the Kami War.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Notable kami". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the war's twentieth year Michiko Konda frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Konda; O-Kagachi's death merges the two realms.
timeline.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kyodai strips the Konda family of their hereditary rule; future rulers will be elected by the kami.
timeline.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takeshi Konda steals the essence of a kami from the Kakuriyo on the night of Michiko's birth, imprisoning it and awakening O-Kagachi, beginning the Kami War.
timeline.quote: this act awoke the prisoner's parent, beginning the Kami War .

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kyodai brings Michiko into the Kakuriyo and gives her the power to fight alongside her.
timeline.quote: After that, she gave Michiko the power to fight alongside her.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai defeat Konda and O-Kagachi and become guardians of the barrier between realms.
timeline.quote: defeated Konda and O-Kagachi and claimed themselves the guardians of the barrier between the Utsushiyo and the Kakuriyo.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko's mother dies in childbirth; Konda neglects his daughter, leaving her with Lady Pearl-Ear.
timeline.quote: Her mother died in childbirth

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Choryu helps Michiko escape Eiganjo; she meets Toshi Umezawa in Jukai, who saves her from the Myojin of Life's Web.
timeline.quote: After saving her from the wrath of the Myojin of Life's Web

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko and her party are at Minamo during Hidetsugu's attack and Toshi saves them.
timeline.quote: Once again, Toshi Umezawa saved her and her friends.

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko shatters the disk, freeing the Taken One, who becomes Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters and destroy O-Kagachi.
timeline.quote: together they destroyed O-Kagachi

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kyodai punishes Konda; the sisters become the new guardians of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: Kyodai later punished Konda for his crime as well.

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year, O-Kagachi first manifests, devouring three thousand warriors and defeating the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: It also defeated Hidetsugu's master, the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos easily.

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "First Manifestation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the night of Michiko's birth, Lady Pearl-Ear informs Lord Konda, who seems uninterested.
timeline.quote: The story starts on the night of Michiko's birth.

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Prologue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Years later, Michiko, Choryu and Riko escape Eiganjo Castle but are separated and tricked into the kitsune village by Sharp-Ear.
timeline.quote: They manage to leave the castle

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part I". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Both groups are captured by orochi in Jukai; Toshi escapes, finds Kobo dead, and rescues Michiko from sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Toshi rescues Michiko who is going to be sacrificed by the Myojin of Life's Web to stop the war.

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi reveals Choryu killed Kobo and sends him flying away; Toshi escapes in mist.
timeline.quote: Toshi reveals that it was Choryu , not the orochi, who has killed Kobo

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes through the Shadow Gate and barters with Night's Reach for teleportation power, kills Uramon, teleports Michiko to Pearl-Ear and mercy kills Choryu.
timeline.quote: Toshi also teleports to Hidetsugu's lair and mercy kills Choryu despite knowing it would enrage Hidetsugu.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko speaks with Mochi at Minamo, learning what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, as Toshi learns the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa and Hidetsugu attacks Minamo.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly the academy is rocked as Hidetsugu attacks.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi freezes Mochi and drops the Taken One at his feet, hoping Konda, O-Kagachi and Hidetsugu will fight over it, then teleports Michiko's party back to Jukai.
timeline.quote: Back at Minamo he freezes Mochi with his ice powers and drops the Taken One at his feet

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko sends a kanji message to Toshi; Eiganjo has fallen and the soratami are conquering in Takenuma and Jukai.
timeline.quote: Eiganjo has fallen, Takeshi Konda is missing, and the soratami are conquering in the Takenuma and Jukai.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One, who is named Kyodai; O-Kagachi manifests all eight heads.
timeline.quote: Toshi suggests " Kyodai ", meaning "sibling"

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai merge and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads; Konda is turned to stone and shattered.
timeline.quote: Konda then shows up but is quickly turned to stone and shattered

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The sisters take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology and plan a blending of the two worlds.
timeline.quote: The sisters then take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko uncovers the real cause of the Kami War with Kyodai's support, facing opposition.
timeline.quote: she made the bold choice to uncover the real cause behind the Kami War for all to see

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Reign of Truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Toshi release the Taken One in Jukai Forest; she takes the name Kyodai and binds her power with Michiko.
timeline.quote: took the name Kyodai and bound her power with Princess Michiko Konda

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kyodai and Michiko immobilize and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off its remaining heads.
timeline.quote: bit off O-Kagachi's remaining heads, then cast the limp body aside

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai assume O-Kagachi's role as guardian of the veil; the war ends.
timeline.quote: The war ended soon after the Serpent's defeat

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Centuries later the Sisters order Leshrac to leave their plane.
timeline.quote: the Sisters stood in his way and ordered him to go away from their plane.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Future Sight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko Konda entrusts the future to her sister.
timeline.quote: now I must entrust the future to my sister.

citation.text: Brilliant Restoration (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Michiko Konda bonds with Kyodai, ending the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Michiko Konda brought an end to the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.

citation.text: Portrait of Michiko (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chiyoko hands over cudgels made when Michiko was young.
timeline.quote: These were made when Michiko was young. Wield them wisely.

citation.text: Bronze Cudgels (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Michiko is posthumously styled the first emperor of a new Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: styling her as the first emperor of a new Kamigawa

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Choryu helps Michiko escape Eiganjo, trapping their kitsune mentor Sharp-Ear in water, intending to bring her to Minamo Academy.
timeline.quote: Choryu took the initiative and helped her to escape

citation.text: "Choryu", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sharp-Ear escapes and separates Michiko from Choryu and Riko; Choryu's patron spirit reprimands him.
timeline.quote: reprimanded him for taking Michiko from Eiganjo

citation.text: "Choryu", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Choryu and Riko reunite with Michiko in Sugi Hayashi and the party heads for orochi country, where they meet Toshi Umezawa and Kobo.
timeline.quote: The party met Toshi Umezawa and Kobo .

citation.text: "Choryu", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year Michiko Konda, aided by Toshiro Umezawa, frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Lord Konda, ending the war.
timeline.quote: managed to free the kidnapped scion

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Conflict". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi gives That Which Was Taken to Michiko Konda, ending the Kami War.
timeline.quote: gave That Which Was Taken to Michiko Konda

citation.text: "Myojin of Night's Reach", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pearl-Ear is present at Michiko's birth and brings the news to Konda, who is behaving strangely; she flees in fear.
timeline.quote: she felt a terrible portent from his words and the mood of the room and fled from there in fear

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko, aged 20, sneaks from Eiganjo and is taken from Sugi Hayashi by Toshiro Umezawa.
timeline.quote: but Michiko was taken away by the rogue Toshiro Umezawa

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko arrives guided by Sharp-Ear's foxfire, and Riko and Choryu are brought in by Silver-Foot.
timeline.quote: until Michiko Konda arrived guided by a foxfire light cast by Sharp-Ear

citation.text: "Sugi Hayashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Captain Nagao arrives demanding the Princess's return but must stay because of the akki threat.
timeline.quote: demanding the return of the Princess to her home

citation.text: "Sugi Hayashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko's party leaves for the lands of the orochi following Silk-Eyes' vision.
timeline.quote: it was decided that Michiko's party would leave Sugi Hayashi to go to the lands of the orochi

citation.text: "Sugi Hayashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the climax of the war Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters Michiko and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "The Reckoning". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
